title: View detailed information about an audio file
summary: Use the built-in `afinfo` command to see technical details about an audio file, such as its format, duration, and sample rate. This is useful for checking file properties without opening a media player.

aliases.text: how to see audio file details
kak posmotret info o audio fayle

steps.explain: Run `afinfo` followed by the path to your audio file to display its full technical metadata.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: The path to the audio file you want to inspect.

alternatives.explain: Use the `--brief` flag to get a concise, one-line summary of the file's format and duration.

alternatives.explain: Use the `--info` flag to see the file's metadata tags (like artist, title) and InfoDictionary contents.
